issue.title: test_start_monitor_scrubs_agent_identity_from_the_supervisor_env fails deterministically on athena: supervisor env keeps SASE_AGENT

task_type_fields.why_not_flake:
Found by the sase-1ou land agent on 2026-10-28 in guarded check ToolRun 22bfd6827fb1ab3efcc70f0a3214bef3 on athena, at sase master 86c3250e69 plus a flake-baseline text edit only.

`tests/monitor/test_monitor_start_supervisor.py::test_start_monitor_scrubs_agent_identity_from_the_supervisor_env` fails deterministically at line 155: `assert 'SASE_AGENT' not in captured_env`. The env captured from the supervisor Popen still carries `SASE_AGENT`. A focused rerun failed, and it still failed with every `SASE_*` variable unset from the invoking shell. So it is not leaking from the agent session that ran it.

Neither the test nor `src/sase/monitor/start_launch.py` / `src/sase/procs/spawn.py` changed since 2026-10-10. Scheduled Full CI 40728370252 at 641dfbb588 did not report this node. Either a commit between 641dfbb588 and 86c3250e69 changed scrubbing indirectly, or something host-specific on athena feeds `SASE_AGENT` into the spawn env. The root cause is not identified, so this is sized large.

payload.description: Need existing CI task reports before corroborating just-check failures

evidence.note: Relayed from sase-1ph.3 note #1 by sase-1ph.land. Reproduced on clean sase master 60a4fe8a92 (2026-10-28): this node and tests/monitor/test_monitor_start_ack.py::test_start_monitor_kills_a_supervisor_that_never_writes_the_ack_marker (assert 6 == 1 at line 472) both fail in isolation; both also failed in sase-1ph.3 ToolRuns 29c4b2417bb0dcc409b70b7315689be3 and clean-HEAD 8b1f2b6154a49cd37f8de6d9b1705377. Likely root cause, from a Popen-logging probe: the product scrub works. The supervisor spawn (.venv/bin/python ...) is launched with SASE_AGENT absent. Both tests monkeypatch the process-global subprocess.Popen, so they also capture unrelated git subprocesses that start_monitor now runs on athena (git rev-parse/status -- sdd/config remote.origin.url, plus one 'git -c rerere.enabled=false ... rev-parse --show-toplevel' with an explicit env that DOES carry SASE_AGENT). The scrub test merges every captured env, and the ack test counts every spawn (6). Fix direction: filter captured calls to the supervisor spawn (e.g. by pass_fds or argv), not the scrub code. The ack-marker node has the same cause, so no separate task was filed.
